scope: Document-level planning, drafting, structural review, revision staging, and multi-document operations; grammar/English semantic ownership stays in English/PTGAE services; publication acceptance stays with receiving publisher.

comparators.product: Content Guardian Agents and automated content governance

comparisonTasks.task: Classify claim-bearing source fragments into a human-authored document plan or abstain
comparisonTasks.meetMetric: blind human-labeled top-1 accuracy, including abstentions
comparisonTasks.beatCriterion: Higher accuracy at equal/lower false assignment rate than a measured vendor baseline; no vendor baseline yet.

comparisonTasks.task: Produce accurate multi-section drafts with exact source references
comparisonTasks.meetMetric: unsupported claims, missing citations, material source omission per 100 claims
comparisonTasks.beatCriterion: Lower critical error rate than a measured vendor baseline with comparable task inputs.

comparisonTasks.task: Find true repetition, omissions, reading issues and editorial gaps
comparisonTasks.meetMetric: precision and recall on independently marked examples
comparisonTasks.beatCriterion: Better F1 and no increase in harmful false positives.

comparisonTasks.task: Rewrite only admitted spans, preserve evidence and original voice
comparisonTasks.meetMetric: semantic drift, source protection violations, human acceptance and refusal accuracy
comparisonTasks.beatCriterion: Lower harmful-change rate with higher useful accepted-edit rate than measured baseline.

comparisonTasks.task: Batch thousands of sections with deterministic identity and bounded work
comparisonTasks.meetMetric: throughput per compute dollar, peak memory, p95 latency, reproducibility
comparisonTasks.beatCriterion: Meet SLA and beat an actually observed comparable throughput/cost baseline.

comparisonTasks.task: Stop unauthorized edits/publication and detect stale source revisions
comparisonTasks.meetMetric: all negative controls refused, independent reviewer/audit readback
comparisonTasks.beatCriterion: No unapproved side effects across a qualified red-team corpus.

localImplementation.proofBoundary: Deterministic lexical claim placement, original-claim rendering, bounded section concurrency, structural review, exact SHA and no-overwrite CLI. It is not generative semantic understanding or product parity.
